prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='catboost', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ARIMA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while catboost leads in seasonal capture (0.412), but ONLY_DWT_rf dominates overall RMSE (16.88) with exceptional early horizon performance (2.02). With unstable rankings (Kendall τ=0.193) and high model disagreement (RMSE spread=4.12), robust median/trimmed-mean combinations are preferred over stacking to avoid overfitting noise and concept drift.
